title: Slab reinforcing and retaining-wall waterproofing tested against Acceptable Solutions (Mt Roskill, Auckland)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE, Building Act 2004): comparative test only; not an Alberta case; no Alberta applicability asserted
code_edition: NZ Building Code B1 and E2 with B1/AS1 and E2/AS3 as cited
document_type: MBIE determination under Building Act 2004 s188 (regulator decision on an individual matter); not an applicant's alternative-solution file

facts.text: Owner's 1960s house has a basement double garage with concrete block walls set into a sloping bank, with retaining walls of 1,050 mm block and 300 mm timber-framed sections.
Two items: (1) reinforcing bars in a concrete slab floor; (2) waterproofing the retaining walls with a damp-proof membrane.
Determination limited to whether the items comply by the relevant Acceptable Solutions (B1/AS1 para 2.1.1; E2/AS3); it states that AS compliance is one, but not the only, way to comply.
Conclusion: NZS 4229 commentary C7.8.3, relied on by the owner, is not part of B1/AS1; the E2/AS3 weathertight-concrete code of practice excludes retaining walls including basement walls.
Decision: Item 1 does not comply with B1 by B1/AS1 para 2.1.1; Item 2 does not comply with E2 by E2/AS3 (1 April 2022).

limitations: Comparative only: a New Zealand determination used to test attachment format and content; it cannot establish Alberta performance or applicability.
